mcqs.question: For the phase 1 Musi Riverfront Development Project in Telangana, what loan amount did the Centre clear from the Asian Development Bank (ADB)?
mcqs.explanation: The Centre cleared an Asian Development Bank loan of ₹4,100 crore for phase 1 of the Musi Riverfront Development Project. The figures ₹20 crore, ₹250 crore and ₹100 crore are not the approved loan amount; ₹20 TMCFT refers to water to be lifted, while ₹250 acres and ₹100 acres relate to land sought and agreed.
